Key item features

  • Personalized Audio: CustomTune technology delivers premium, personalized sound, ensuring an optimal listening experience tailored to the individual.
  • Superior Noise Cancellation: Features the best Bose in-ear noise cancellation with ActiveSense adaptive technology for effective sound blocking.
